The purpose of the show was for contestants to place a bid closest to the price of the showcased item without going over. There were four contestants on each show, and one of those…

I had the pleasure to meet (and work for) one of the first contestants for the price the right. He lives in a retirement home in Lynchburg VA now and I can’t remember his name.
